接近边界时柔和减速: Slow down gently near the limits
只在继续向外转头时减速，往回看不减速。角度上限仍然有效。: Slows outward movement near a limit. Looking back inward keeps normal sensitivity. The angle limits still apply.
到达转头限制后，继续拖动来探头: Keep dragging past a look limit to lean
顶到向下或左右上限后，继续拖动才伸展。位移直接跟随鼠标，停下保持，反向拖动先收回: Reach the down or side limit, then keep dragging to lean. Lean follows mouse input, holds when you stop, and retracts when you reverse. Sensitivity affects lean only; normal looking is unchanged. At 35%, full extension takes about 43 degrees of additional equivalent mouse input.
需开启转头角度限制。幅度为游戏距离单位，设为 0 可分别关闭。: Requires look limits. Distances use game units. Set either distance to 0 to disable that lean axis.
前伸时额外低头: Extra downward angle while leaning forward
到原低头限位后，前伸与额外低头同时进行，反向同时收回。最多越过垂直向下 5°（总: Forward movement and extra downward rotation blend together beyond the normal down limit, and retract together. Maximum total angle: 95 degrees (5 past straight down). Set to 0 for translation only. Both use lean sensitivity.
侧伸时额外转头（左右各）: Extra side angle while leaning (each side)
到原左右限位后，侧伸距离与额外转角同步变化。默认每侧多转 10°，原限位 80°: Side movement and extra rotation blend together beyond the normal side limit. The default adds 10 degrees per side: an 80-degree limit becomes 90 degrees at full lean. Set to 0 for translation only. Reverse input retracts both together.
数值越小，近处衣服越完整；水雾等粒子可能穿过地形显示。此项只作用于第一人称。: Lower values keep nearby clothing visible, but mist and other particles may show through terrain. Applies only in first person.
解除另一层按距离隐藏整个对象的判断，仅在第一人称生效。针对走该判断的角色与物件；: Disables a separate proximity rule that hides entire objects, only in first person. Covers characters and objects using that rule; some static scenery, unloaded objects and back-face culling are not covered.
坐下、躺下及同类固定/循环动作期间，普通右键和直控都只转镜头，避免转身打断动作。: While sitting, dozing or in similar stationary/looping emotes, both ordinary right-drag and direct mouse look turn only the camera. Movement keys still end the pose normally.
第一人称下，移动鼠标直接转动视角: Direct mouse look in first person
默认锁定视角；按一次快捷键呼出鼠标，再按一次恢复转视角。: The mouse controls the view by default. Press the hotkey to release the cursor, then press again to resume mouse look.
默认锁定视角；按住快捷键呼出鼠标，松开后恢复转视角。: The mouse controls the view by default. Hold the hotkey to release the cursor; release it to resume mouse look.
直控时按住左键可自由观察，镜头转动不带动人物朝向；松开左键恢复右键式直控。自由观: Hold the left mouse button for free look without turning your character. Release it to resume right-button-style mouse look. Look and lean limits still apply.
支持单键或 Ctrl / Alt / Shift 组合。录制单独修饰键时，按下再: Supports a single key or Ctrl / Alt / Shift combinations. To record a modifier alone, press and release it. Game keybinds still work, so avoid conflicts. Release the cursor before clicking UI elements.
设置窗口、文字输入或切出游戏时自动释放；关闭设置、结束输入或返回游戏后恢复。退出: Automatically releases the cursor for settings, text input or focus loss, then resumes when finished. Leaving first person restores normal mouse control.
保留正常骨骼，只在主画面隐藏对应模型。发梢和饰品不再局部保留，脸部模型内的颈部也: Keeps normal bones and hides selected models only in the main view. Hair tips and accessories cannot be partly preserved; neck geometry inside the face model may also disappear. Separate rabbit ears are identified by resource path. Unusual mods may still obstruct the camera. Enable your own character's shadows in the game.
原骨骼隐藏方式：保留颈部，头影会随头部隐藏。: Standard bone hiding preserves the neck; the head's shadow is hidden along with the head.
进入时，镜头接近后再隐藏: Delay hiding until the camera approaches the head
进入距离越小，隐藏越晚；退出距离越大，恢复越晚。: A smaller entry distance hides later. A larger exit distance restores the head later.
保留远离镜头的发梢: Keep hair tips away from the camera
保留远离镜头的耳部及关联饰物: Keep ears and accessories away from the camera
范围越大，遮挡越少、保留越少。仅支持能识别的头发和耳部骨骼；若出现发丝拉伸或耳部: A larger radius hides more and reduces obstruction. Only recognized hair/ear bones are supported. Disable the relevant option if hair stretches or ears obstruct the view.
减弱贴近镜头的自身特效: Reduce your own effects near the camera
0.25 表示最贴近时保留四分之一强度。仅处理施放者和目标均为自己的可识别效果，: 0.25 retains one quarter of the opacity at the closest distance. Only recognized effects cast by you on yourself are affected, based on the whole effect's position. Some weapon effects are not covered.
请在游戏的角色设置中，将第一人称视角自动调整（1st Person Camera: In Character Configuration, set 1st Person Camera Auto Adjustment to Never. Native left-button free look and right-button recentering remain available. Settings save automatically.
视点位置始终跟随头部。以下开关额外让画面方向跟随头部动画。: Camera position always follows the head. These options also let camera orientation follow head animations.
关联度控制转动幅度，平滑控制跟随速度。50% 表示头部转动 60°，镜头跟随约: Weight controls rotation amplitude; smoothing controls response speed. At 50%, a 60-degree head rotation contributes about 30 degrees to the camera, subject to look limits. Mouse sensitivity is unchanged.
部分动作可能产生较大的画面倾斜。: Some animations can produce a large camera tilt.
第三人称也启用视点绑定: Also bind camera position in third person
显示头部位置与方向辅助线: Show head position and direction guides
辅助线需同时启用第三人称视点绑定，并保持此设置窗口打开。: Guides require third-person camera binding and this settings window to remain open.
完整头影试验不可用，已使用原骨骼隐藏方式。: Full head shadows are unavailable. Standard bone hiding is being used.
限位探头输入不可用；转头限制仍有效，请查看 Dalamud 日志。: Lean input is unavailable. Look limits still work. Check the Dalamud log.
近处物体保留不可用，请查看 Dalamud 日志。: Nearby-object visibility is unavailable. Check the Dalamud log.
鼠标直控/固定姿势保护不可用，请查看 Dalamud 日志。: Direct mouse look / stationary-pose protection is unavailable. Check the Dalamud log.
设置窗口打开时，自动释放鼠标。: The cursor is released while settings are open.
初始化暂未完成，正在自动重试；详情见 Dalamud 日志。: Initialization is retrying. See the Dalamud log for details.
等待角色与相机加载完成。: Waiting for the character and camera to load.
头部隐藏不可用，请查看 Dalamud 日志。: Head hiding is unavailable. Check the Dalamud log.
自身特效减弱不可用，请查看 Dalamud 日志。: Self-effect attenuation is unavailable. Check the Dalamud log.
打开 POV+ 设置；/pov toggle 切换启用状态: Open POV+ settings; /pov toggle enables or disables POV+
自动跟随 Dalamud 界面语言；修改立即生效。: Auto follows the Dalamud UI language. Changes take effect immediately.
把青色十字移到两眼之间的鼻梁处。: Move the cyan crosshair to the bridge of your nose, between your eyes.
左键拖动绕看角色，滚轮缩放。可把这个窗口拖到一旁，露出脸部。: Hold the left mouse button to orbit; scroll to zoom. Move this window aside to see your face.
先从正面调左右和上下，再从侧面调前后：视点贴近鼻梁表面，不要放在鼻尖或头部深处。: Adjust left/right and up/down from the front, then forward/back from the side. Aim for the surface of the nose bridge, away from the nose tip or deep inside the head.
青色十字是实际视点，可透过模型显示；请从正面和侧面都确认一次。: The cyan crosshair marks the actual viewpoint and shows through the model. Check it from both the front and the side.
拖动数值可调整，Ctrl+点击可直接输入；－/＋ 每次微调 0.001。: Drag a value or Ctrl+click to type. The - / + buttons adjust by 0.001.
正在等待角色头部加载，暂时无法显示视点。: Waiting for the head to load; the viewpoint is temporarily unavailable.
视点不在画面内，请转动或拉远镜头，或将偏移归零。: The viewpoint is off screen. Orbit, zoom out, or zero the offsets.
保存后，用游戏原有方式切入第一人称。之后可在 /pov 顶部重新进入校准。: After saving, enter first person with the normal game controls. Reopen calibration at the top of /pov anytime.
切到第三人称，用图示和实时标记调整两眼之间的视点。请在正常场景、非战斗状态下使用: Switch to third person and align the viewpoint between your eyes with diagrams and a live marker. Available during normal gameplay, outside combat.
示意图正在加载或暂不可用；仍可按文字说明调整实时视点。: The illustration is loading or unavailable. You can still use the instructions and live viewpoint marker.
贴近鼻梁，不是鼻尖: At the bridge, not the tip
